QM
Quiet Market
Quiet Market: the homes that aren't for sale. Yet.
Prototype v4 for internal review. No postcards are printed or posted from this page. Views are computed house by house: one viewpoint at the upper windows and one in the garden of every address point, from Environment Agency 1 m LIDAR, OS OpenMap Local buildings, OS Open UPRN and Copernicus terrain. Sale records and address points meet at the postcode, so counts of homes with a given view are estimates. Likelihood figures come from a real model trained on HM Land Registry Price Paid Data (England & Wales, 1995–2019, 24.3M transactions; out-of-time AUC ). Air quality and health-access figures are real, from AHAH v4 inputs. Drive times are approximated from straight-line distance, not routed. Offer figures use a proof-of-concept pricing rule, an assumption until campaign data exists. Demo cities: Exeter and Bath.
